user.title: Connect to Ford securely
user.description: SafeConnect 0.2.0 alpha uses FordConnect Query (read-only). Register an application at the Ford Developer Marketplace and provide its OAuth Application Credentials. This integration does not wake your vehicle or provide remote commands.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Ford account
reauth_confirm.description: Reconnect your account through Ford's official consent screen. SafeConnect will continue honoring its request budget.

abort.authorization_failed: Ford authorization failed. Verify your app credentials and consent.
abort.no_vehicle: Ford did not return one vehicle with a valid VIN.
abort.select_one_vehicle: Select exactly one vehicle on Ford's consent page.

init.title: SafeConnect cloud request budget
init.description: Requests read cached cloud data; they never force a vehicle update. Default is 60 minutes; permitted 15–1440 minutes. There is no guaranteed safe polling frequency.

data.poll_minutes: Minimum minutes between Ford cloud queries
